svg.title: A dead heater: the residual and the running sum
svg.desc: The heater stops heating at step 120. From then on the thermostat keeps it switched on and every reading is about a degree below the model's prediction. The running sum leaves zero and passes the threshold 17 steps later, where an ordinary day never got above 3.
svg.text: what the room did minus what the model said
